tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po bzhi'i gsol kha bzhugs so//

bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lhar// gus btud mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// bstan srung dge bsnyen chen po bzhi'i// gsol mchod bstan pa'i btsas su bri// gzhi ma dkar gtsang gi steng du 'bru dkar gcal du bkram pa'i dbus rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i nang du lha bshos dkar zlum dang*/ btsan bshos dmar po zur gsum/ klu bshos dkar zlum sbrul gyis dkris pa/ sman bshos dkar zlum bu pang gi rnam pa can rnams dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i mthar// g.yag lug ra gsum/ mtheb skyu/ ril bu/ kong bu/ chang bu rnams bcu phrag yan chad kyis bskor ba bshams/ de dag gi mdun du rin po che'i snod du/ phud gtsang la gser dngul zangs lcags kyis sbags pa'i gser skyems dang*/ ja chang*/ 'o ma/ khrag rnams snod so sor bshams pa'i mdun du mchod pa ji ltar 'byor ba'ang bshams/ sgrub po stan bde bar 'khod cing*/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas gtor mchod rnams/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis dngos 'dzin ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor mchod ngo bo dag cing rmad du byung ba 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin can lha btsan klu sman 'khor bcas dgyes dgu bskyed pa'i mthun rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ oṃ gyis gtor ma'i dri ma sbyangs/ āḥyig gis rgya mtsho lta bur spel/ hūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsgyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥs sbyangs spel sbar ba'i 'dod yon nam mkha'i khams thams cad kun nas gang bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ sarba bid+yā pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya a warta ya hoḥbadz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer dzaḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa rang rang gi gnas su 'phros pas/ chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po lha btsan klu sman rang 'khor dpung sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis spyan drangs/

badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ kye/ shākya'i bstan la shākya'i rgyal po mchog /'phags pa'i yul du nā gardzu na zhes// gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// bstan srung dge bsnyen che bzhi spyan 'dren no// gzhu 'grung lha lung phu gsum sa 'dzin rtser// gangs dkar shel gyi khang bzang na bun gyi// lhab lhub cod pan ngom pa'i pho brang nas// lha chen bar lha 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /'di nas shar phyogs g.ya' spang stugs po'i dbus/ /nam mkhar bsreg za 'phyo 'dra'i brag gi rdzong*// sna tshogs rkang 'thung nyer bkra'i pho brang nas/ sog ra btsan 'khor bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs// sman ljongs rtsi shing sna tshogs bkra ba'i dbus// gnam sngon thang la lhags pa la 'khu ba'i| |dug can mtha' bral 'jing zab pho brang nas// chu 'phan klu yi 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// grub dbang pad+ma'i drag po'i gnas kyi gtso// brag dkar dung seng mkha' la 'phyo 'dra'i bdag /chos dang nor gter du ma'i srung ma che// ti sgro sman gyi tshogs bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// gzhan yang tsog sna'i rnam rgyal dkar po sogs// 'bri gdan chos phyug klung sogs gzhi yi bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag kun// mchod gtor bzhes slad gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ kye| rin chen las grub pho brang nyams re dga'// mchod gtor gser skyems 'dod yon bag re dro// rnal 'byor brtse gdung lhag bsam dam re gtsang*// dge bsnyen srung ma 'khor bcas brjid re chags// sna tshogs dar zab rin chen gdan yangs par// mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ hoḥ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang dbang bka'| |bar du slob dpon pad+ma'i lung*// tha mar mgon po 'bri gung pas// u pa si ka'i bka' drin stsal// de tshe lha btsan klu sman ni// rang 'khor bcas pas khas blangs shing*// dam bcas don de dran par mdzod// bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' ste// rtag tu khyod rnams gsol mchod bgyid// khyod rnams dam las ma 'da' bar// snying po'i bstan pa bsrung bar mdzod| |gal te dam las khyod 'das na// bka' dang 'gal ba'i chad pa ni// gnam lcags rdo rje'i mtshon cha yis// khyod kyi mgo dang snying bkas nas// rdo rje dmyal bar sreg par byed| |de bas dam srung phrin las sgrubs// sa ma ya a mṛ ta khā hi na rak+kan// zhes dam la bzhag

/kye/ lha btsan klu sman dang bcas pa'i// dge bsnyen rnam bzhi 'khor dang bcas// so sor dgyes skong mchod pa'i rdzas// yan lag brgyad ldan ar+ghaṃ gtams// dri bzang chab kyi zhabs bsil dang*// chu dang thang skyes me tog bkra// sbyar dang rang byung bdug spos 'thul| |mun sel mar me mdangs dang ldan// sna tshogs spos kyi dri chab dang*// ro brgya ldan pa lha'i zhal zas// glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgra sgrog cing*// gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim dang*// ro mchog reg ldan mkho dgur ldan// sman raka gser skyems spyan gzigs dang*// so sor mthun pa'i gtor mar bcas// spyan gzigs dgyes skong sna tshogs pa// rang rang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas rnams// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa// nam mkha'i khams rnams yongs bkang ste// lha btsan klu sman dge bsnyen bzhi// 'khor dang bcas la bdag 'bul gyi// dgyes par bzhes la tshim par mdzod// snying po'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// rnal 'byor bsam don 'grub par mdzod// oṃ nā tha tsa mā rī rā tri dharma swa mi rat+na shrī tsa tur u pa si ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she pañtsa a mṛ ta ba ling+ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis mchod gtor rnams 'bul/ kye/ chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po bzhi// bskang ngo gsol lo thugs dam bskang*// de ring dpal gyi dam tshig bsre// de ring mgron gyi bya dga' 'bul// de ring sngar bcol gtang rag gtong*// de ring phyis bcol zhu skyems gsol// de ring da 'chol gnyer zas 'bul// de ring mthun pa'i rdzas kyis mchod// de ring nyams chag zhig ral gso// mthun pa'i yas rnams bdag gis 'bul// dgyes pa'i zhal bzang khyod kyis ston// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang*// mchod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// nyer spyod rnam lngas thugs dam bskang*// 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// g.yab dar g.yab mos thugs dam bskang*// bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dkor mdzod nor gyi thugs dam bskang*// rten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// brten gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang*// bza' ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// mchod sbyin gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// btung pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sman dang rak+tas thugs dam bskang*// rgyun gyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rgyun gtor nar mas thugs dam bskang*// rtags kyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rtags gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang*// brngan pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// gser skyems mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// spyan gyi dbang po tshim pa'i phyir| |sna tshogs gzugs kyis thugs dam bskang*// snyan gyi dbang po tshim pa'i phyir// glu dbyangs rol mos thugs bskang*// shangs kyi dbang po tshim pa'i phyir// dri zhim spos kyis thugs dam bskang*// ljags kyi dbang po tshim pa'i phyir// ro mchog zas kyis thugs bskang*// sku la dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// dar zab gos kyis thugs dam bskang*// thugs kyi dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// mdza' sdug grogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// pho rgyud tshogs rnams mnyes pa'i phyir// dpa' bo chang gis thugs bskang*// mo rgyud tshogs rnams mnyes pa'i phyir// rak+ta dmar gyis thugs bskang*// klu rgyud tshogs rnams mnyes pa'i phyir// dkar mngar sman gyis thugs dam bskang*// rta mdzo g.yag lug ra la sogs| |dkor nor phyugs kyis thugs dam bskang*// gsol lo mchod do srung ma'i tshogs// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// bskang ngo gsol lo thugs dam bskang*// bskangs gyur phrin las 'grub pa dang*/

/chos rje mgon po 'bri gung pa'i/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// snying po'i bstan pa srung ba dang*// spel zhing yun ring gnas par mdzod| |ces thugs dam bskang*/ hoḥ chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po rnam pa bzhi// rnal 'byor bdag la gsan zhing dgongs su gsol// khyod ni gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag gtso| |chos rje'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// snying po'i bstan srung dam la gnas pa che// bdag ni rgyal dbang mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// rigs dang chos kyi gdung mtsho ba brgyud 'dzin te// lha dang mi dag rdo rje'i tshig dam pos// sngon nas 'brel ba'i rten 'brel rmad byung bas// mi 'bral tha chad dam la gnas lags kyang*// le lo'i dbang gis gsol mchod g.yel zhing 'gyangs// ma 'byor nongs pas 'byor tshogs zhan pa dang*// tshig don chad lhag nor 'khrul nyams pa sogs// dge bsnyen rnam bzhi'i thugs dang 'gal ba rnams// rnal 'byor nongs pas de ring bshags bgyid kyi// tshangs par mdzod cig gzhi bdag gnas po'i tshogs// bshags kyang mi tshangs mchod kyang mi dgyes na// sngon gyi dam 'gal srung ma'i ltung bar 'gyur// de bas tshangs pa mchog gi dgyes rang mdzod// ces bshags shing yig brgya brjod/ kye/ gzhu 'grung lha lung gnyan po'i gung shed na// lha yi sku mkhar srid pa'i gangs las grub// shel dkar rtse rgyal 'dzam gling rgyan du che// sa 'dzin dbang po chu shel gyis byugs pa// dgung zla'i 'od kyis lan brgyar spags pa ltar// na bun chu 'dzin thod bcings rab tu brjid// zhol 'dabs sman ljongs nags kyis yid bde spel// sum brtsen mkhar gyi dpal rab 'phrog pa'i nang*// sna tshogs rin chen las grub gzhal yas dbus// 'o de gung rgyal phag ma btsan dgu dag /bshos pa'i sras la lha chen bar lha zhes// zhi ba'i cha lugs dung gi skyes bu che// g.yu yi skra dang smin ma dung gi tshems// le brgan ljags ldan spyan gsum bstan pa srung*// dar dkar na bza' srid gsum srid rtser g.yo// phyag na mda' dar sba lcag brjid ldan bsnams// res 'ga' sprul bsgyur na bza' stag slog la// seng chen gong lag rin chen ska rags can// dbu la rgod kyi lcog zhu nyi zla yi// kha spun dang ldan dar gyi cod pan spur// phyag na shel dkar ber ka 'gying zhing bsnams// chibs su gro bo seng gdong mgyogs pa bcibs// drag po'i skur ston dpa' bo'i go cha can// dngul khrab steng na za 'og gnam lcags kyi// ske rags dang ldan dbu la shel dkar rmog

/dar mtshon gyis brgyan phyag na mdung dmar bsnams/ /dung rta dkar po zhon nas stong gsum nyul/ /dmu bdud lha klu'i lcam mo khyod kyi grogs// de sras bdud dmu lha klu btsan dang bcas| |stong 'gram la sogs phyi blon sum cu gnyis// gcung ri la sogs nang blon sum cu gnyis// tshe blon la sogs phyag brnyan sum cu gnyis// go tshang la sogs g.yas kyi ru 'dren tshogs// gshin po bye ri la sogs g.yon ru 'dren// cong bu la sogs klad kyi skyel ma'i tshogs// sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs lha btsan klu gshin rje// bdud dang ma mo gnod sbyin sman btsun dmu// yang sprul stong gsum khengs pa'i lha 'khor bcas// lha chen bar lha'i tshogs la bdag bstod do/ /kye/ 'di nas nyi ma shar phyogs gzhu yi phu// nor 'dzin gser gyi khu bas sbags 'dra'i ljongs// chu skyes sna tshogs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston la// brtse ba'i rkang drug tshogs rnams glu dbyangs len// spu sdug ri dwags gar mkhan bro gzhas rdung*/ */ rkang mthung margad 'dab ma'i gos klubs shing*// 'dab ldan lang tsho ge sar 'dzum phreng g.yo// 'bras bu'i bcud kyi pha 'bab lus can tshim// gtsang ma'i nyal 'gro g.yu yi bzhin ras can| |dbu ba'i 'dzum mdangs rlabs kyi zur mig gis// skom sred 'dod ldan skyes bu'i yid dga' spel// lus med dga' mas chu 'dzin 'dzum phreng gi// zol gyis bstod pa'i dbyar rnga dal gyis sgrog /khu 'phang me tog char gyis shis pa brjod// de 'dra'i dbus su byu ru'i sdong po ni// til mar snying pos lan brgyar byugs pa lta'i// brag dmar rtse rgyas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten snyeg /na bun lang ling rgyal po'i la thod bzhin// rtsi shing 'dab rgyas de yi gos la 'gong*// de 'dra'i sku mkhar btsan gyi gzhal med khang*// de dbus dbugs bral gdan la btsan gyi rje// sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i byin za ltar// drag po'i am gtsigs rno dkar mche ba bltams// dmar ser ral pas srid rtse khengs shing 'phyo| |gos ling dmar chen ber brjid lhab lhub mnabs// phyag g.yas phur bu dar dmar cod pan pur// g.yon pa btsan zhags dmar gtor che 'jigs bsnams// gser gyi ska rags sag lham yu ring gsol// rdzong bzhi'i btsan sogs btsan 'khor bye bas bskor// rnam sprul res 'ga' rta pho ngang zhur bcibs// ber dkar gsol zhing ru dar dkar po 'phyar| |res 'ga' rag pa stag la chibs su bcibs// ber ser ru dar ser po mkha' la 'phyo// res 'ga' mtshal bu gzig khra zhon nas kyang*// ber dang ru dar dmar po me ltar 'bar| |res 'ga' bya rgyal khyung dang seng ge dang*// sman sha yu mo la sogs ma nges pa'i// bzhon pa gos dang phyag mtshan cir yang bsgyur// sog ra btsan gyi tshogs la bdag bstod do| |kye/

nyi ma lho phyogs tsa mā rī yi ljongs// rgya mtsho'i gos can g.yu yi lang tsho can// 'dab ldan sna tshogs ge sar skra yi phreng*// mdzes pa'i len bus skye dgu'i khengs pa 'phrog /sman gyi ljon pas nyes gsum nad kun 'joms// bde bar spyod pa'i glu mkhan bh+ra ma ra// sbrang rtsis myos pa'i mgrin rgyas dus kun rtsen// gnyis skyes sna tshogs mkha' la nyer spyod cing*| |rnam bkra ri dwags tshogs rnams bde bar rgyu// 'bab chu lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgra rgyun gyis// dub pa'i lus can kun yid rings nas tshim// de dbus zla shel lan brgyar bzhu ba yi| |khu ba 'khyil la margad mdangs bzang gis// bskus pa ji bzhin rin chen 'byung gnas ni// dbyibs legs kha dog rab mdzes mtha' dbus bral// gting zab 'jing du lha mi'i dpal 'byor gyis// 'gran par mi bzod dgos 'dod kun stsol ba'i// nor bus gtams pa'i pho brang de dbus su// gdengs can kun gyi dbang po chu 'phan klu// sku mdog bai ḍūr chen po'i rigs lhag cing*// na bza' mthing 'od sa gsum mdzes par 'khu// phyag na ru dar nam mkha'i mdog can bsnams// dbu la dar zhu dbang sngon mdangs mnabs shing*// chu yi gyi ling sngon po chibs su bcibs// res 'ga' sku mdog nam mkha'i rna ba 'dra// lto 'gro'i gdengs ka chu 'dzin ltar gtibs shing*// rin chen rgyan mang dgos 'dod char du 'beb// drag por chas tshe dug can ltar 'phyo zhing*// mun pa'i mdangs 'tshub kha rlangs nad du 'bar// gtum po'i 'od ltar dug gi 'od stong g.yo// mthong reg dran pas dug gi nyams pa sgrol// rgyal rje dmangs dang bram ze gdol pa sogs// stong gsum gdengs can tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas// chu 'phan klu yi tshogs la bdag bstod do// kye/ nub byang sgo yi mi 'gyur ti sgro'i gangs// drag po'i gnas chen gter sgrom brag dkar zhes// grub dbang pad+mas drag po'i gnas kyi gtsor// bsngags shing bzhugs pa'i sgrub gnas ngo mtshar can// dam pa chos dang dbul sel nor gyi gter// bgrang yas bzhugs pa'i pho brang che 'jigs rngam// brag dkar dung gi gdong lnga lha lam du// legs par 'phyo 'dra sprin dang na bun g.yo// dbyar rnga'i sgra yis sa gsum 'dar zhing dngangs// yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bab// sgong skyes ri dwags tshogs rnams bder spyod cing*// 'bab chu hūm̐ phaṭa drag po'i nga ro sgrog

/rtsi shing nags tshal ngam nag skyi g.ya' 'jigs// dur khrod ma mo sha za ce spyang sogs// 'jigs pa'i gad rgyang srid gsum rngam sgra sgrog /skal ldan rnal 'byor don gnyis dngos grub len// skal med nyams pa'i tshe srog tshogs su rol// ma mo mkha' 'gro bgrang yas spyod pa'i gnas// de 'dra'i mnga' bdag sman gyi gtso mo ni// cha lugs ma nges sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar// mkha' la spyod tshe ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshul// gnyug mar gnas tshe gzhi bdag sman gyi tshul// sa 'og rgyu tshe bran dang pho nya'i tshul// sa steng rgyu tshe sna tshogs cho 'phrul gzugs// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'jig rten la gnas tshul// sman 'khor bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas// ti sgro sman gyi tshogs la bdag bstod do// gzhan yang 'bri gdan se ba byang chub gling*// chos kyis phyug pa'i klung gi gdags dang srib// kun la gnyug mar gnas pa'i tshogs kun la// mchod cing bstod kyi snying po'i bstan pa srungs// gang bcol phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod// ces bstod/ gtor ma phyir spags la/ kye/ 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// bka' bsgos dam bzhag dge bsnyen nyid stsal ba'i// gnyug mar gnas pa'i gnas po rnam pa bzhi// gsol lo mchod do snying po'i bstan pa srungs// gser dngul zangs lcags dar zab sman dang 'bru| |rta g.yag ra lug mdzo 'bri rkang bzhi'i tshogs// gser skyems longs spyod mkho dgu'i pha 'bab kyis// lha chen bar lha gsol lo phrin las mdzod// rta dmar bse yi ya lad go mtshon bcas// mdung zhags dar tshon chang khrag gser gyi skyems// bsgral ba'i sha khrag sna tshogs longs spyod kyis// sog ra btsan rgod mchod do phrin las sgrubs// dkar gsum mngar gsum la sman rtsi sman dang*// chu rta sngon po rin chen rgyan gyis spras// gser skyems g.yu phreng dar zab rin chen gyis// chu 'phan klu dbang mchod do phrin las sgrubs// 'dod yon sna lnga'i phyi nang nyer spyod tshogs// dar zab 'bru sman spos dang rin po che// gser skyems bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs kyis// ti sgro sman bcas mchod do phrin las mdzod//

sman raka gtor ma dkar dmar rgyan gyis brgyan// spyan gzigs sna tshogs nam mkha'i khams khyab pa// dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin 'gran// phye mar bsang dang mkho dgu'i longs spyod tshogs// chos rje'i dge bsnyen bzhi la 'bul gyis bzhes// 'jig rten mgon po rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i// bstan pa rin chen dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ */bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs pad rab brtan cing*// 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams 'dun zhing 'brel ba dang*// chab srid lha 'bangs ches cher rgyas par mdzod// de la sdang byed log 'dren dgra dang bgegs| |log par lta ba zhi ba'i thabs kyis thul// rgyas pas zil gnon dbang gis rab bsdus la// bdag gi bran dang 'bangs su bkol bar mdzod// gal te zhi bas thul bar mi 'tshal ba'i// skal ngan nyams pa'i phyi nang dgra bo rnams// gang la bya dmigs khyod kyis shes gyis la// skad cig bla khug dbugs 'phrog tshe srog phrol// drag pos sgrol la sha khrag zhal du thob// bsad rtags don snying dmar po khyer la shog /grub dbang thod phreng rtsal dang 'jig rten mgon// rat+na shrī'i bka' dang dam tshig las// ma 'gal ma 'da' dge bsnyen chen po bzhi// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs shig sa ma ya// zhes gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul/ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ shis brjod bsngo ba smon lam skabs sbyar bya'o// de ltar chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po bzhi la gsol mchod skabs su bab pa 'di'ang*/ sngon chad dge bsnyen so sor gsol mchod ma gtogs phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa cher mi 'dug pas/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i bstan pa'i btsas dang rang gi bar gcod srung ba la sogs pa dgos pa skabs su bab pa'i don 'ga' zhig mthong ba la brten/ 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i rigs las dus mtha'i sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rje zhes sam/ chos kyi grags pas gsol kha snga ma rnams la gzhi byas shing skabs su gang bab kyis kha bskangs te/

nyi ma'i lo nag pa can gyi dmar po'i rgyal ba gnyis pa'i dus su bab par/ pho brang chen po rtse ba gzhis kar sbyar ba ste 'di ni rang re 'bri gung par gtogs pa rnams kyis gsol mchod bgyi ba'i 'os su che bar mthong bas de ltar 'bad rigs so// //maṅga laṃ//
